integrity: Analytic proof establishes all-dimensional signed-Gram sufficient condition, star comparison, strictness, uniqueness, and asymptotic ratio. Finite symbolic/numerical assertions are reproducible but not a substitute for the proof. A preexisting special star optimal-weight formula is not claimed as novel; prior precedence comparisons remain qualified.
scientific_limitations: Exact all-but-one-coordinate block minimization on real SPD quadratics, fixed iid omission probabilities, sharp worst-direction one-step conditional expected H-energy. The star-volume-versus-uniform inequality holds only for the 3-by-3 family with 0<c<1/sqrt(2). No wall-clock, multistep-optimality, adaptive, approximate-solve, or higher-dimensional volume-comparison claims.
title: A sharp volume-versus-uniform reversal for two-coordinate sampling on SPD stars
